headline: Gaia The Fierce Knight
title: Gaia The Fierce Knight Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Gaia The Fierce Knight. What is it? It is a Level seven EARTH Warrior Normal Monster with two thousand three hundred attack. What does it do? It has no effect. It is a knight whose horse, as the card says, travels faster than the wind. How do you use it? It is a classic Fusion material, and it is in Starter Deck: Yugi Evolution with Yugi's other classic monsters. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
